window.basis: wire timestamps of PANEL; 1 s bins use VCD clock

limits: Diagnostic build only; not the frozen S1/S2/S3 ELF.
GPIO marker covers executed foreground scopes, including ADC and I2C polling inside active tasks; empty not-due checks and inter-task spin are excluded.
IRQs during a marked interval are included; ISR work outside those intervals is excluded.
Marker writes and altered execution perturb timing; empty pulse width is not total probe overhead.
Asynchronous UART wire time is not CPU time; only foreground TX setup and formatting are marked.
PANEL wire timestamps include serial-queue latency; 1 ns VCD timescale is not a physical accuracy guarantee.
